_purpose: What local_coder_driver.py needs beyond context-budget.json and skills.json, so it submits to the coder model exactly what aider-plan.ps1 submits to aider (owner 2026-11-05, Issue #104 plan 13). Lists are data, not code (R6).

code_extensions.provenance: copied 2026-11-05 from aider-plan.ps1 lines 77-79 ($CodeExtensions), so a plan names the same targets for both harnesses

aider_config_dir.provenance: where setup.ps1 installs aider-setup and where aider-plan.ps1 reads context-budget.json, skills.json, conventions.md, rules.md and skills/ (owner 2026-11-05: all aider process is here); the driver reads the same files

write_message.value: Execute {plan}. Follow the working protocol you were given. Every source file you create or change must have a matching test file, written in the same step as the code and not deferred: a step is not done until its test exists and passes. Write into progress.md anything the next plan needs to know. Do not read or act on any other plan, and do not move or rename any file.
write_message.provenance: aider-plan.ps1 lines 988-995, copied 2026-11-05; the ticking sentence is dropped because the driver ticks progress.md itself from the test result

fix_message.value: The tests of {plan} failed. Their output is below. Fix the code and its tests, and return every file you change in full. Do not read or act on any other plan, and do not move or rename any file.
fix_message.provenance: aider-plan.ps1 lines 997-1002 (reopen), adapted 2026-11-05 to a failing test run, which aider answers in its own fix loop

reopen_message.value: The audit reopened {plan}. In the '## {plan}' section of progress.md, address every line still marked '- [ ]', including the ones beginning 'audit:'. Fix the code and its tests. Do not read or act on any other plan, and do not move or rename any file.
reopen_message.provenance: aider-plan.ps1 lines 997-1002, copied 2026-11-05; the ticking sentences are dropped because the driver ticks progress.md itself from the test result

reply_format.value: Reply with every file you create or change, each in full in its own fenced block whose first line is '# file: <path relative to the repository root>'. Use four backticks for a file that itself holds three-backtick fences. Do not return progress.md.

test_timeout_s.provenance: proposal 2026-11-05, tuned at the owner's review: one plan's offline suites; context-budget.json tests.command has no timeout of its own

request_timeout_s.provenance: proposal 2026-11-05, tuned at the owner's review: a 14336-token reply at a few tokens per second when the window spills to CPU; the bridge's own 300 s is sized for one short file

failure_lines.provenance: proposal 2026-11-05: lines of failing test output kept, from the end, in the fix prompt and in the ledger reason

audit_exclude.provenance: aider-plan.ps1 lines 837-840 (Get-ProjectFingerprint skips .git/, __pycache__/, .venv/ and .aider.*), copied 2026-11-05 for the audit sandbox (plan 15); .venv widened to any .venv* folder, the repository's own name pattern

git_timeout_s.provenance: proposal 2026-11-05, tuned at the owner's review: one git status, rev-parse or checkout on the repository (R10)
